Veterinary Practice Analytics

Turn Years of Appointment Data Into a Clear Growth Plan

Scape builds a live analytics dashboard from your veterinary practice management software — surfacing client retention gaps, appointment forecasting, and revenue trends your spreadsheets can't show you.

Book a Free Demo

Sound familiar?

Client retention is hard to measure across wellness visits, sick visits, and boarding separately.

Seasonal demand swings make staffing and scheduling guesswork.

Missed appointments and reschedules quietly reduce revenue every month.

Reporting across multiple locations means stitching together spreadsheets by hand.

What we track for you

Built directly from your existing systems — no new software for your staff to learn.

Client retention rate

See which clients haven't returned within their expected interval.

No-show / reschedule rate

Understand where scheduling friction is costing you revenue.

Revenue per visit

Compare performance across services, providers, and locations.

New client acquisition

Track new clients against marketing spend and referral sources.

Appointment forecasting

Anticipate seasonal demand swings before they hit your schedule.

Multi-location comparison

Compare performance across every clinic from one dashboard.

How it works

1

Connect

We connect to your practice management system and pull appointment, billing, and client data automatically.

2

Build

We build dashboards tailored to how your clinic actually operates — single-location or multi-site.

3

Predict

AI models forecast demand and flag clients at risk of not rebooking.

4

Act

Your team gets one weekly view to work from, rather than reports from five different systems.

See your clinic's numbers, automatically.

Book a free walkthrough and we'll show you what this looks like with your own data.
